comments.author: skybellrock
comments.body_html: May I suggest adding a multiplier for the different item categories for their insurance price? I feel like certain things such as ammo is far too cheap to ensure and global insurance multipliers from other mods does not seem to affect it.

comments.author: skybellrock
comments.body_html: Correction. It does take into account global modifiers. The problem is that insurance treats a whole stack of ammo as one. So whether you have one singular bullet or a stack of 60 the insurance for it is the same.

comments.author: CreamCheese
comments.body_html: That’s a limitation of the game engine. Bullets were never intended to be treated as an item that can be insured because they are stackable. You’ll notice that every item in default Tarkov that can be insured isn’t stackable, because BSG never intended for stackable items to be insurable, including medical items. This isn’t something we can change very easily unless someone can figure out how to code that into the game client and server. At the moment, this is the only way ammo can be insured without massive changes to the client side and or server side.

comments.author: skybellrock
comments.body_html:
Would it be possible to still add a multiplier for only the items affected by the mod? Then you could say multiply by 60 and just kinda accept that you’ll pay more if you want to insure less than a stack.

I’m sure there are smart solutions for coding it so that it adapts price to amount too, if you can retrieve the amount of ammo in a stack I don’t see why it cannot be done. I understand if that is too massive of an undertaking though. But just the multiplier would be lovely at least.
